dependency_model.hard: blocks only if upstream absence makes the action unsafe, logically invalid, or unverifiable
dependency_model.soft_external: does not block unrelated safe work
dependency_model.waiting_for_google: technical remediation may pass while indexing outcome remains pending
dependency_model.policy_guard: do not bypass protected code, arbitrary-code, paid-service, commerce or credential guards

original_final_gate_rule: Phase 15 remains skipped/unassessed; never convert exclusion into a fabricated PASS or 10/10
execution_rule: finish every safe independent action; separate external telemetry and Google latency from intrinsic phase acceptance
